newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas freight firm names logistics chief.
newsitem.headline: Danzas freight firm names logistics chief.

text.p: Freight forwarding concern Danzas AG said it had named Michael Proffitt, former executive director of Hayes Logistics, as head of global logistics services.
A Danzas statement said Proffitt, 48, would be based at the Basle head office and report directly to chief executive Peter Wagner.
Danzas said Proffitt's appointment would "reinforce its top position in the fast growing international logistics markets".
A Danzas spokesman said the global logistics post had been enhanced under a new structure and was now responsible for all projects that crossed divisional lines.
"The head of global logistics is in the position of holding together those projects that include more than one division, such as air and land freight or sea and air," the spokesman said.
The Danzas statement said Proffitt would work closely with an increasing number of customers looking for integrated global freight solutions and would manage Danzas's key accounts.
